title: Nomad (Consolidated Outland, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Nomad is a small single-seat freighter from Consolidated Outland in Star Citizen. The cockpit sits ahead of an open cargo deck and a small living space. It uses the common controls without changes.

panels.name: Nomad: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Nomad's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (three)
controls.text: The Nomad has three guns for the pilot. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (eight missiles)
controls.text: The Nomad carries eight missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: Cargo and tractor beam (24 SCU)
controls.text: The open deck takes 24 SCU, loaded with the help of a tractor beam (a beam that pulls and moves objects).
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Nomad: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Nomad besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Remote turret
controls.text: One remote turret on the Nomad. It is aimed through a camera from inside the ship.
controls.context: A remote turret is aimed from a seat inside the ship through a camera, not from a glass bubble on the turret itself.
